title: M.A.R.G Journal
tagline: Multidisciplinary research journal website, branding, and paper submission platform.
shortDescription: Website design, brand identity, and research paper submission platform for the multidisciplinary M.A.R.G research journal under Painganga Publication.
description: Mehkar Analysis And Research Gazette (M.A.R.G) Journal is a multidisciplinary research journal under Painganga Publication. Developed full website, brand identity, paper submission workflow, and digital management.

caseStudy.problem: The journal needed an academic web presence, branded identity, and an intuitive research paper submission pipeline to launch its publication operations.
caseStudy.solution: Designed and developed the official journal website on WordPress/Elementor, built a multi-step paper submission workflow using Forminator, and crafted the official logo and digital branding.
features: Custom academic journal website built with WordPress & Elementor
Multi-step research paper submission workflow powered by Forminator
Published issues catalog and research article repository
Original logo design and academic brand identity
Hosting setup and domain configuration on Hostinger
Social media presence setup and ongoing digital management
caseStudy.challenges: Structuring an intuitive research submission workflow with manual payment verification and clear academic formatting guidelines for authors.
caseStudy.outcome: Successfully launched the official M.A.R.G Journal website, establishing its digital presence and paper submission channel for Painganga Publication.
caseStudy.learnings: Client project management, WordPress/Elementor customization, academic publishing workflows, and digital brand management.
